", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u033-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "He did not budge.", "sha256": "eb95d9a8b2dacb8ec157b842f7b5409e0235f21d700f37d1cb1af4661ecf265c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[18]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u033-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "I whispered again:", "sha256": "2a82b84963b256c4a0d4f27a4c8a21c7d5a5583dd326d0eed0330704b6ff9e14", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[20]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u033-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“King, it must not be. You must go.”", "sha256": "8447d3c0d5dc2c11775c1c835574d4fbc85e0bae37c499f0aff62bf5b2612b0c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[37]/p[21]", "source_html": "

“King, it must not be. You must go.”
